mapper.select: select m.id, m.content, m.images, m.like_count as likeCount, m.create_time, coalesce( (select wc.author from sys_web_config wc order by wc.id desc limit 1), (select a.name from sys_author a order by a.id desc limit 1), '博主' ) as nickname, coalesce( (select wc.author_avatar from sys_web_config wc order by wc.id desc limit 1), (select a.avatar from sys_author a order by a.id desc limit 1) ) as avatar from sys_moment m order by m.create_time desc
